title: Options Ex-Dividend Calendar Massive
description: Upcoming-dividend feeder for the Options Edge Brief watchlist. Calls Massive.com /v3/reference/dividends to surface declared dividends with ex-dividend dates within the next 90 days for each of the 40 watchlist tickers. Per ticker, returns: ex_dividend_date, pay_date, cash_amount, frequency, declaration_date, record_date, days_to_ex_div. Used by the Options Edge Brief to flag picks affected by ex-div windows - because the underlying drops by approximately the dividend amount on ex-div day, ITM call pricing reflects this and ATM calls held into ex-div appear to lose value abruptly. The brief filters: (a) skip naked-call sells in the ex-div window (early-exercise assignment risk on deep-ITM calls), (b) flag covered-call writers about to be called away, (c) note that calendar spreads spanning the ex-div date have non-trivial pricing distortion. Helper feeder; not a standalone signal. Massive.com Options Starter (or even any tier with dividends-endpoint access) sufficient. API budget: 40 calls per run (one per ticker, paginated lightly).
